chunks: Ali ibn al-Sindi from Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"There is no objection to a man coming to Mecca, performing Tawaf during the days of Mina, and not spending the night there."

key_terms.أَيَّامَ مِنًى: The days of Mina (specifically the days of Tashriq)
key_terms.يَطُوفَ: He performs Tawaf (circumambulation of the Kaaba)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform Tawaf in Mecca without staying overnight in Mecca during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the flexibility of Hajj rituals, specifically addressing the permissibility of performing Tawaf in Mecca while residing in Mina during the days of Tashriq. It reflects the scholarly consensus on the separation of ritual acts from residential requirements, emphasizing ease (*rukhas*) in the performance of Hajj obligations. The ruling is particularly relevant for pilgrims managing the logistical demands of the multi-day stay in Mina.
